definitions.beta_at_50x: PACS-Full with fixed screening and a variable acceptance gate. Reference LEPA policies use the same 50x traces.
definitions.serial: Immediately issue the next I/O after the host consumes the previous completion. PACS acceptance and screening beta both equal 1.
definitions.percent_changes: Per-trace latency ratio minus one, times 100. Negative means a lower latency.
